title: agent-team-pack/1
description:
Manifest of a downloadable Agent Team OS pack (team.json at the root of the pack). One format for both kinds of pack: a single agent (agents[] of length 1) and a full team.

SECURITY INVARIANT: a pack carries NO executable code. Markdown and JSON only - personas, roles, avatars, skill and command documents. The installer never runs anything out of a pack. A persona is still prompt text that will steer an agent, so the installer MUST display it before installing (see 'persona' below).

MERGE INVARIANT: installing NEVER mutates AGENT_MAP.json without an explicit confirmed diff. Back up the map before every merge. Uninstalling removes the pack and its map entries but MUST leave inboxes/ and threads/ intact - reinstall and the history is still there.

schema.description: Format discriminator. An installer seeing an unknown value MUST refuse the pack rather than guess.

id.description: Globally unique pack id, also the extraction directory (~/.agent-team-os/packs/<id>/).

requires.description: Minimum host versions. The installer refuses the pack when unsatisfied instead of installing something half-supported.

agents.description: Roles shipped by the pack. Length 1 is the 'single agent' case that the store lists separately.

id.description: Proposed AGENT_MAP key. COLLISION IS EXPECTED and is exactly what the merge diff is for: on collision with an existing agent the installer offers rename-on-install, never silent overwrite.

is_god.description: A pack requesting god mode MUST be surfaced prominently in the install diff: it is an escalation, not a detail.

persona.description: Pack-relative path to the persona markdown, e.g. 'personas/alita.md'. This text becomes the agent's system-level instructions, so the installer MUST show it in full before installing. Path MUST stay inside the pack: no absolute paths, no '..' traversal.

avatar.description: Pack-relative PNG path, a remote https URL, or a generation request. See avatar rules in PLAN 11.2: closed style set, prompt built server-side, no real-person likeness, always skippable.

style.description: Closed set. Style is a property of the TEAM, not the individual: mixed styles turn the Agentic window into a collage.

seed.description: Reproduces the same face across regenerations.

accepts_intents.description: Message intents this role accepts, mirroring AGENT_MAP.

suggestedWorkspaces.description: Suggested workspace paths, e.g. '~/work-hub'. SUGGESTIONS ONLY: a path that does not exist leaves the agent 'unassigned' (WorkspaceAgent.assigned=false) rather than creating anything.

routing.description: Suggested routing, merged into AGENT_MAP only on confirmation.

mode.description: full-mesh is the protocol default since v1.3 (2026-06-09).

hub.description: Agent id receiving non-blocking cc-notify for cross-domain traffic.

deprecated.description: Pack retired by its author. Stays installable for existing users, hidden from the store listing.

examples.name: Indie Builder Team
examples.description: Five roles for building solo: tech partner, dev, marketing, PM, tech lead.
